title: Extension Skeleton Scaffolding
description: Create the basic VS Code extension project structure with package.json, src/extension.ts, and build scripts targeting VSCodium.

title: Local WebSocket Daemon Bridge
description: Implement the secure WebSocket handshake between the extension host and the Rig Relay daemon using token-based authentication.
acceptance: Extension successfully authenticates with the daemon

title: Mission Control Sidepanel
description: Implement the Mission Control sidepanel using a Webview View to project agent chat and status.
acceptance: User can submit prompts via the sidebar

title: Governed Patch Review Interface
description: Integrate with the VSCodium native diff view to review and approve/reject file modifications proposed by agents.
acceptance: Proposed patches open in a diff view
Clicking Approve applies the patch via the daemon

title: Evidence Receipt Tree View
description: Implement a Tree View in the Rig sidepanel to browse and open evidence receipts from the daemon's ReceiptStore.
acceptance: Tree view shows list of recent receipts
Opening a receipt displays the rationale in a custom editor
